description: Find which published authorities on the NOMOS Exchange govern something you are about to do, from a plain description (e.g. "deploy a recruitment model in the EU"). No name needed. Returns the matching authorities ranked, and for each the facts it reads that match your description (what to pass to ask_authority as inputs) and its most relevant rules with where they come from in the source. Also returns authorities others have requested that are not listed yet. Matches by words and by meaning (a small multilingual model on the server, so questions in Arabic and other languages work); it only chooses what to ask, never a verdict. Call this before ask_authority when you do not know the authority's name.

description.description: What you are about to do, in plain words.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction tag to restrict to, e.g. "EU" or "AE".

name: find_authority

facts.description: Input fields this authority reads that match the description.

matched_terms.description: Words of the description that matched. Empty when it matched by meaning alone (e.g. a question in Arabic).

places.description: Jurisdictions the description names (e.g. AE for Dubai). An authority that covers none of them is not returned.

search.description: How the search ran: method "hybrid" (meaning and words) or "keyword", and the model used for meaning.
